title: Planning to open source the code that makes this possible, anyone here would be interested in using this in their games? :)
author: tomeks

comments.author: tomeks
comments.body:
Basically you enter a coordinate and prompt and get a tiled transformed image like that. You can then also be able to upscale these images to past gigapixel in size as seen here:  
[https://www.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusion/comments/1chxup2/138\_gigapixel\_image\_zoom\_in\_video\_of\_gothic/](https://www.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusion/comments/1chxup2/138_gigapixel_image_zoom_in_video_of_gothic/)

See my other examples and updates here:

[https://twitter.com/DiscoverStabDif](https://twitter.com/DiscoverStabDif)

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: 1000x yes. Ive often thought this would be amazing for CRPGs like balsursgate2 etc. Or even tabletop maps. Are you using comfyui and some type of tiled technique? Love your work!

comments.body: this is incredible, is it possible to make it more detailed?
